title: 第21章 凝神丹第22章 不停找麻烦
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
雷系灵根，说是天之骄子，一点也不为过。
同样，一些邪修对这种罕见的灵根，同样是兴趣盎然。
邪修之中，可是有专门的夺基大法，可以直接吞噬灵根属性。
这哪里是什么雷系灵根，分明是一个烫手的山芋。
保护？
还是自己的小命要紧。
三小姐许雯秋冰雪聪明，一眼看出李凡的犹豫，立刻补充道，“李供奉，我们家族会派一名炼气期大圆满的修士，负责主要的保护任务，另外，还有四名炼气后期的修士，负责策应。而您呢，只是负责外围的协助任务。
当然，这次还是老规矩，全凭李供奉自己定夺，如果同意，本商盟会奉上一份厚重的宝物。”
“宝物？”
李凡眼前一亮，西凤商盟毕竟财力忠厚，宝物众多，上次探寻筑基期前辈府邸，西凤商盟提供的宝物，起到扭转乾坤的关键作用。
沉思片刻，李凡继续确定的问，“嗯，需要保护多长时间，还有一点，我不太明白，如果是雷系灵根，各大门派应该早派人保护啊！”
“嗯，只需要保护三五天，至多十天。
至于雷系灵根的问题，我们家族这名弟子，目前只是呈现双灵根，有一点变异的趋势，必须等待高人进一步确认。”
权衡利弊，李凡还是点头答应，除了一些好奇心，李凡还是没能抵抗宝物的诱惑。
“多谢李供奉！夜里三更，店铺后门，会有人接应你，告辞！”
三小姐不等李凡回复，已经灵光一闪，幻化成白面小生，姗姗离开。
李凡无奈的摇头，看来为了雷系灵根，这个家族的希望，整个西凤商盟都已经草木皆兵。
苦涩！
雷系灵根，天之骄子，看看这待遇，这重视程度。
可是自己呢，一个和凡人一般的垃圾杂灵根，真是没法比，天壤之别。

闲话少叙，夜里三更，李凡悄悄打开后门，果然一个身影，正在这里等候。
“李供奉，我是西凤商盟的伙计，请跟我来！”
伙计在前领路，不时的四下打量，显得十分谨慎，戒备心十足。
李凡也不停打量，生怕有什么人尾随。
不过，一路顺利，伙计竟然带着李凡来到一处十分破落的小宅子。
“这？”
李凡有一点诧异。
“李供奉，请随我来！”
伙计用暗号敲门，一位随从模样的人，细致的查看一下，这才放行。
伙计直接将叶凡带到小院子的西厢房，移动一个橱柜，里面竟然是一个狭窄的走廊。
穿过走廊，别有洞天，竟然是一个地下建筑，墙壁布满月亮石，整个地下建筑奢华，明亮，凸显西凤商盟的财力。
“李供奉，欢迎，欢迎！”
三小姐还是白天时候的装扮，只是没有易容。
content_en:
It is no exaggeration to say that he is the proud son of heaven with his thunder spiritual roots.
Similarly, some evil cultivators are also very interested in this rare spiritual root.
Among evil cultivators, there is a special foundation-seizing method that can directly devour the spiritual root attributes.
What kind of lightning spiritual root is this? It is clearly a hot potato.
Protect?
His own life still matters.
Third Miss Xu Wenqiu Bingxue was smart and saw Li Fan's hesitation at a glance, and immediately added, "Li Gongfeng, our family will send a monk who is in the Great Perfection Stage of Qi Refining to be responsible for the main protection task. In addition, there are four monks who are in the later stage of Qi Refining to be responsible for supporting. As for you, you are only responsible for peripheral assistance tasks.
Of course, this time it is still the old rule, it is entirely up to Li Gongfeng to make his own decision. If he agrees, the merchant alliance will present a heavy treasure. "
"Treasure?"
Li Fan's eyes lit up. After all, the Xifeng Merchant Alliance had strong financial resources and many treasures. The treasures provided by the Xifeng Merchant Alliance during the last exploration of the residence of the seniors in the foundation-building period played a key role in turning things around.
After pondering for a moment, Li Fan continued to ask with certainty, "Well, how long does it need to be protected? One more thing, I don't quite understand. If it is a lightning spiritual root, the various sects should have sent people to protect it early!"
"Well, it only needs protection for three to five days, ten days at most.
As for the issue of thunder spiritual roots, this disciple of our family currently only has dual spiritual roots, and there is a slight tendency of mutation. We must wait for further confirmation from experts. "
After weighing the pros and cons, Li Fan nodded and agreed. Except for some curiosity, Li Fan still couldn't resist the temptation of the treasure.
"Thank you Li Gongfeng! At three o'clock in the night, someone will meet you at the back door of the store. Say goodbye!"
The third lady didn't wait for Li Fan to reply, but she had a flash of inspiration, transformed into a white-faced young man, and left slowly.
Li Fan shook his head helplessly. It seemed that for the sake of the thunder spiritual root and the family's hope, the entire Xifeng Merchant Alliance was on the move.
Bitter!
He has the spirit root of thunder, he is the proud son of heaven, look at this treatment, this level of attention.
But as for me, a garbage spirit root like a mortal is really incomparable, a world of difference.
Without further ado, at three o'clock in the night, Li Fan quietly opened the back door, and sure enough, a figure was waiting here.
"Li Gongfeng, I am a guy from the Xifeng Merchant Alliance, please come with me!"
The waiter led the way, looking around from time to time, appearing very cautious and alert.
Li Fan kept looking around, fearing that someone was following him.
However, the journey went smoothly, and the boy actually took Li Fan to a very rundown small house.
"This?"
Li Fan was a little surprised.
"Li Gongfeng, please come with me!"
The clerk knocked on the door with a code, and a person who looked like a follower checked carefully before letting him in.
The clerk took Ye Fan directly to the west wing of the small courtyard and moved a cabinet, which turned out to be a narrow corridor.
Passing through the corridor, there is a cave. It turns out to be an underground building with walls covered with moon stones. The entire underground building is luxurious and bright, highlighting the financial strength of the Xifeng Merchant Alliance.
"Li Gongfeng, welcome, welcome!"
The third lady is still dressed as she was during the day, but without the disguise.
